battle.name: 梁與北魏的戰爭
battle.brief: 503年三月，北魏宣武帝元恪趁南梁新立，遣任城王元澄率兵五萬，與降魏的蕭寶夤、陳伯之並力攻梁朝鍾離城，另遣鎮南將軍元英攻義陽。戰事延至527年，陳慶之率五千騎破魏十萬援軍直抵洛陽。兩軍用環首刀、戟、槍、弓弩及皮甲札甲；卡面科林斯青銅盔早本役一千一百五十年，不在淮水陣上。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 這場戰爭是南朝梁與北魏在江淮前線長達二十四年的對抗，起於503年三月（北魏景明四年、南梁天監二年），至527年（北魏孝昌三年、南梁大通元年）才因形勢變化而收束。南梁一方是502年十月由蕭衍在建康南極殿即皇帝位新建的王朝，天監二年時立國未久，軍隊仍沿用南齊的宿衛與州郡兵制：京師禁軍由領軍將軍與各衛率府分掌，地方則以鎮、州兩級將軍和刺史領兵，士卒多為江南鄉兵與北來流民，步卒以刀、戟、弓弩列陣，騎兵編制相對單薄，攻守都倚賴水軍與淮水沿線的城池。梁的後勤線自建康經秦淮河、姑孰溯淮而上，糧秣靠船運至鍾離、壽陽一帶的戍點。北魏一方是孝文帝遷都洛陽之後的北方帝國，宣武帝元恪在尚書令北海王元詳等重臣主持下，倚仗以鮮卑騎兵為骨幹的軍隊，從洛陽、譙城一帶分道南下，步騎配合、器械齊備，糧道則循黃河與淮水支流運轉。第三方同樣重要：南齊殘餘降將蕭寶夤、陳伯之投奔北魏，熟悉淮南城防、水勢與渡口，被魏廷用為嚮導，直接把北軍的攻擊點推到梁的門戶之前。
countriesEn: This war was a twenty-four year confrontation between the Liang dynasty of the south and Northern Wei along the Jiang-Huai front. It opened in the third month of 503 (the fourth year of Northern Wei's Jingming and the second year of Liang's Tianjian) and closed only in 527, the third year of Xiaochang in Wei and the first year of Datong in Liang, when the shape of the whole region changed. On the southern side stood a dynasty created only months earlier: in the tenth month of 502 Xiao Yan had taken the imperial throne at the Southern Pole Hall in Jiankang, and when the war began the Liang military system was still the Southern Qi system, with capital guards distributed among the Lingjun generals and the various Weidufu commands, and local troops raised by military governors and commandery officials at the zhen and prefecture levels. The bulk of the soldiers were Jiangnan country levies and northerners who had fled south; infantry fought in line with sabres, halberds, bows and crossbows, the cavalry establishment was comparatively thin, and both offence and defence leaned on river troops and on the garrison towns strung along the Huai. Liang's supply line ran from Jiankang up the Qinhuai and past Gusu to the Huai, with grain and provisions carried by boat to the garrisons at Zhongli and Shouyang. Northern Wei, for its part, was the northern empire that had moved its capital to Luoyang under Emperor Xiaowen; under Emperor Xuanwu Yuan Ke, with the Northern Sea Prince Yuan Xiang and other great ministers directing affairs, it relied on an army whose backbone was Xianbei cavalry, marching south in separate columns from Luoyang and from Qiaocheng, infantry and cavalry cooperating, siege equipment complete, and its grain routes following the Yellow River and its tributaries into the Huai. The third party mattered just as much: former Southern Qi officers Xiao Baoyin and Chen Bozhi had submitted to Wei, and because they knew the rivers, the fords and the fortifications of the Huai region they were used as guides, placing the northern army's point of attack directly at the threshold of the Liang realm.
people: 決定這場戰爭走向的，是南北兩朝皇帝對形勢的不同判斷。梁武帝蕭衍在建康即位的同時，對北魏的態度極為倨傲：他自居正統，視北朝為蠻族政權，遣使往來時書信與接待都多所輕慢，兩國使者互有怨望，這種外交上的僵持很快被魏廷讀作挑釁。北魏宣武帝元恪則在孝文帝死後的權力轉移期裡急於立威，於是以鍾離、義陽為突破口大舉南下，用兵兼有鞏固權位與試探南朝虛實的雙重考量。戰場上最關鍵的兩名北魏統帥是任城王元澄與鎮南將軍元英：元澄統五萬眾攻鍾離，長於持久與圍城；元英善於速戰，一面攻義陽，一面分兵策應，與元澄形成南北兩線。梁方先後倚重的是曹景宗與韋叡，兩人皆出身寒門、以敢戰與多算聞名，鍾離城下築城拒敵、夾淮水立柵，正是韋叡的手筆；蕭衍的宗室蕭宏則在壽陽城下折戟，被貶奪封邑，成了此役中最典型的敗績。蕭寶夤與陳伯之兩位南齊降將，一為北軍嚮導，一在後來成為梁魏之間往來說客；羊侃原為北魏將領，506年歸梁，隨曹景宗赴鍾離，督役築城，並在城上以火攻焚毀魏軍撞車。全戰役最亮的一筆屬於陳慶之：527年他率五千騎在鍾離正面擊潰奚落生率領的十萬援軍，一路追到洛陽城下，逼得魏孝明帝連夜出奔。
peopleEn: What decided the course of this war was the two courts reading the situation differently. Liang Emperor Wu, Xiao Yan, had barely taken the throne at Jiankang when he adopted an extremely haughty attitude towards Northern Wei: he regarded himself as the holder of the true succession, looked on the northern dynasty as a regime of barbarians, and in the exchange of envoys both the tone of his letters and the manner in which the northern guests were received carried a palpable condescension, so that the envoys of each side went home nursing resentment, and the stalemate in diplomacy was soon read at the northern court as a deliberate provocation. Emperor Xuanwu Yuan Ke, by contrast, had come to the throne during the unsettled transfer of authority that followed Emperor Xiaowen's death and was in a hurry to assert himself; his offensive against Zhongli and Yiyang was therefore at once a bid to secure his own position and a probe of the southern court's real strength. The two northern commanders who mattered most were the Prince of Rencheng, Yuan Cheng, who led fifty thousand men against Zhongli and was at his best in protraction and siege, and the General of the Southern March, Yuan Ying, who was at his best in speed, striking at Yiyang while detaching columns to support Yuan Cheng and so forming a two-pronged line north and south. The Liang side relied in turn on Cao Jingzong and Wei Rui, both of humble origin and famed for daring and for calculation; the works raised to hold Zhongli and the palisades set up along the Huai were Wei Rui's work. The Liang prince Xiao Hong, by contrast, broke his teeth before Shouyang and was stripped of his fief, which made him the most typical reverse of the whole campaign. The two former Southern Qi officers, Xiao Baoyin and Chen Bozhi, served the northern army as guide and later as intermediaries between the two courts. Yang Kan, once a Wei general, came over to Liang in 506, marched with Cao Jingzong to Zhongli, supervised the raising of the new works and burned the northern siege engines from the wall with fire. The brightest stroke of the whole war belonged to Chen Qingzhi: in 527 he took five thousand cavalry into the open field at Zhongli, shattered the relief army of Xiluosheng that numbered a hundred thousand, pursued the northern troops all the way to the walls of Luoyang and drove Emperor Xiaoming of Wei out of his capital in the middle of the night.
kits: 卡面這件科林斯青銅盔出自古希臘，約公元前650年的工藝，通體青銅、只有鼻樑與兩側的開眼，全正面遮蔽，源頭可追溯到科林斯與阿提卡。距503年已有一千一百五十年，更在萬里之外，它不可能出現在淮水兩岸的戰場上；它所代表的希臘重步兵裝備，與梁魏所用的中式鎧甲毫無關係。真正上陣的是南北朝形製的頭盔與兵器：頭部是皮冑與鐵札冑，札葉以小片甲葉綴連成兜鍪形，頂端常綴紅絹纓，後腦加垂項護甲以護頸背。冷兵器以環首刀最普遍，單刃直身、刀格向前、刀環纏柄，供單手或雙手握持；另有鐵矛、戈、戟、方天戟一類的長柄兵器，槍即長柄矛，用於正面刺擊，戟可鉤可啄。弓為主兵，弩則以蹶張弩、臂弩配以長矢，箭為竹木桿加骨鏃、石鏃。護具以皮甲為主，重要將領與重裝步兵用札甲，佩護心鏡、護臂、護膝；盾有槍盾與圓盾，以木為胎、蒙皮或髹漆。騎兵著馬鎧與披膊，用馬槍與弓箭，木胎蒙革的鞍韉與鐙是常制。攻城與守城的器械包括雲梯、撞車、拍車、櫓車與拒馬，火炬以松脂膏油製成，用來焚燒敵方的攻城具。糧秣則是粟、麥、稻與鹽，弩弦、竹木、車輜、牛馬，另有走漕船的水運。
kitsEn: The Corinthian helmet on the card is a piece of ancient Greek workmanship of about 650 BC: a solid bronze shell pierced only for the nose and for the eyes, concealing the whole face, with its ancestry in Corinth and Attica. It stands eleven hundred and fifty years before 503 and thousands of miles away, so it could not have been on the banks of the Huai; the heavy Greek infantry equipment it represents had no connection whatever with the Chinese armour worn by Liang and Wei. What actually went into the line were the helmets and weapons of the southern and northern courts. For the head there were leather caps and iron lamellar helmets, the small plates laced together to form a domed shell, usually with a red silk tassel on the crown and a trailing neck guard at the back to protect the nape. The commonest cold weapon was the ring-pommel sabre, a single straight blade with the guard forward and a ring at the pommel wrapped for the grip, taken in one hand or two. There were also iron spears, ge, halberds and the square-bladed fangtian halberd among the long-hafted weapons; the qiang, a long-shafted spear, was for the frontal thrust, while the halberd could hook and could peck. The bow was the principal missile arm, with the crossbow represented by the drawn-foot crossbow and the arm bow shooting long bolts, arrows being shafts of bamboo or wood with bone or stone heads. Body armour was chiefly hide, with lamellar plate reserved for officers and heavy infantry, together with breast mirrors, arm and knee guards; shields were the long shield and the round, wooden with skin or lacquer. Cavalry wore horse armour and shoulder plates and fought with the cavalry lance and the bow, and wooden frames covered with hide served as saddles, with stirrups. The siege and defence repertoire included scaling ladders, battering rams, wall-beaters, tower carts and caltrops, and torches made of pine resin and oil were used to burn the enemy's siege engines. The supplies were millet, wheat, rice and salt, with bowstrings, bamboo and timber, wagons and draught animals, and river transport by barge for the heavier loads.
tactics: 北魏的戰術體系是典型的高平原機動加步步為營。三月出兵的北軍以騎兵先行，步兵與器械車隊隨後，五萬大軍自洛陽、譙城一帶南下直趨鍾離；降將蕭寶夤、陳伯之熟悉淮南渡口與城郭，抵達淮水北岸即築壘立營，架浮橋濟軍，並在鍾離城外挖掘塹壕、布置拒馬，把守軍的汲水與樵採切斷。鍾離城孤立淮水之南，北軍圍而不急攻，寄望糧秣盡則城自破；圍城既久，《魏書》所記軍中疾疫流行，魏廷不得已下令退兵。另一線的元英攻義陽，靠撞車與雲梯硬攻垣牆，別遣騎兵斷梁軍援軍的糧道。梁方的守城術是依城固拒、以弩仰射、以火焚械：羊侃督士卒在鍾離城內外築起新城，魏軍至城下才發覺；羊侃又令士卒持火炬與膏油擲向城下的撞車，焚其具而退敵。507年梁軍轉守為攻，韋叡、曹景宗等夾淮水南北築兩城，斷魏軍浮橋，魏軍攻淮渚城不克，宵遁，梁軍以舟兵追擊於淮水之上。527年陳慶之的戰法是另一個極端的樣本：只取精騎作前鋒，乘魏援軍疲於奔命而陣形未整，直衝其薄弱處，潰而長驅，晝夜兼程直抵洛陽，孤軍深入而糧盡乃還，爾朱榮追騎至其營帳下而不敢逼近。
tacticsEn: Northern Wei's system of war was the classic combination of movement across open country and methodical siege. The army that marched out in the third month put its cavalry in front and its infantry and baggage of siege engines behind, the fifty thousand men pressing south from the Luoyang and Qiaocheng area straight at Zhongli. The surrendered officers Xiao Baoyin and Chen Bozhi, who knew the fords and the towns of the Huai, saw the column established in entrenched camps on the north bank, pontoon bridges thrown across the river to pass the army, and the approaches to Zhongli dug up and seeded with caltrops so that the defenders could no longer draw water or fetch firewood. The city stands isolated on the south side of the Huai, and the besiegers ringed it without storming, trusting that the garrison would surrender when the grain ran out; the siege dragged on, and the Wei histories record sickness breaking out among the troops, until the court had no choice but to order the withdrawal. On the other front Yuan Ying attacked Yiyang with battering rams and scaling ladders against the walls, and detached cavalry to cut the grain road of the Liang relief force. The Liang method on defence was to hold the city, shoot upward with the crossbow and burn the enemy's machines: Yang Kan supervised the raising of new works inside and outside Zhongli, and the northern army discovered the city only when it stood at the foot of the wall; he then had his men fling firebrands and burning oil down onto the rams below, burning them out and driving the assault off. In 507 the Liang turned from defence to offence, Wei Rui and Cao Jingzong raising two works on the north and south banks of the Huai to cut the northern pontoon bridge; the Wei attack on the Huizhu fort failed, the army slipped away by night, and the Liang pursued them along the river with their flotilla. The method of 527 was the opposite extreme: Chen Qingzhi took only picked cavalry as his spearhead, struck the weak point of the exhausted and still disordered northern relief army, and drove straight on through the night and day to Luoyang; cut off from his supplies in a hostile land, he turned back, and the pursuing cavalry of Erzhu Rong came up to his camp tents without daring to close with him.
data: 可以確證的數字並不多，但有幾組可用。戰爭自503年三月起，至527年止，前後約二十四年；北魏首攻鍾離的兵力，據史載為任城王元澄所將五萬人，這是《梁書》與《魏書》都提到的數字。鍾離之圍自三月起延至次年三月前後，前後近一年，最後因魏軍糧秣與疫疾而退。義陽方向由鎮南將軍元英率軍進攻，梁軍援兵未及，梁朝失一州，北魏據之置郡。507年鍾離再戰，魏軍統帥元英所領兵力史稱數十萬，傳本作五十萬；梁軍由韋叡、曹景宗分兵，兵力遠小於魏軍，結果魏軍攻淮渚城失利，死傷以萬計，宵營之後全軍退回，蕭衍隨即乘勝命諸軍收復淮南數城。514年梁豫章王蕭宏攻壽陽不克，士卒死傷萬餘，蕭宏由是貶爵。527年梁將陳慶之以五千騎出，全破魏淮陽大將奚落生所率十萬援軍，斬首數萬，進軍直抵洛陽，孝明帝出奔，爾朱榮率騎追之，至帳下而不敢逼其軍。地理上，鍾離在淮水中游南岸，北距洛陽數百里，南距建康亦數百里水路；義陽在淮水與漢水之交，是南北水陸轉輸的關節。
dataEn: The figures that can be stated with confidence are few, but several sets of them survive. The war ran from the third month of 503 to 527, a matter of about twenty-four years. The strength of the first northern attack on Zhongli is recorded as the fifty thousand men commanded by the Prince of Rencheng, Yuan Cheng, a number given in both the Liang and the Wei histories. The siege of Zhongli began in March and lasted until about the following March, very close to a year, and ended only because the northern army ran short of provisions and was worn down by sickness. On the Yiyang front the general of the southern march, Yuan Ying, led the assault while the Liang relief force had not yet arrived, so the Liang lost a prefecture and Wei set up a commandery there. In the second battle of Zhongli in 507 the northern army under Yuan Ying is described as numbering several tens of thousands, the transmitted text giving five hundred thousand; the Liang, commanded in part by Wei Rui and Cao Jingzong, was far smaller, and the result was that the assault on the Huizhu fort failed with losses counted in ten thousands, the army slipped away by night and fell back, whereupon Xiao Yan ordered the various columns to recover several towns on the Huai. In 514 the Liang prince of Yuzhang, Xiao Hong, failed to take Shouyang with losses of more than ten thousand men, and was stripped of his rank in consequence. In 527 Chen Qingzhi marched out with five thousand cavalry, broke the relief army of a hundred thousand men led by the Wei general of Huaiyang, Xiluosheng, cut down several tens of thousands, drove on to Luoyang and forced Emperor Xiaoming to flee, while Erzhu Rong pursued with cavalry and halted at the camp tents of the southern army without pressing the attack. Geographically, Zhongli stands on the south bank of the middle Huai, several hundred li from Luoyang to the north and several hundred li of water away from Jiankang to the south, while Yiyang lies at the meeting of the Huai and the Han and is the hinge of water and land transport between north and south.
cause: 打起來的原因有遠有近。遠因是南北朝的邊境格局：淮水與漢水之間的州縣長期在兩朝之間易手，鍾離、壽陽、義陽、淮陰一帶是江淮門戶，誰控制這些據點，誰就控制了下游的漕運與北進的跳板。北魏在孝文帝漢化改革與遷都洛陽之後國力上升而重心南移，孝文帝一死，宣武帝初立，北魏廷便有重新整頓南方戰線的需要。近因則在梁朝這一邊。蕭衍502年十月才從南齊手中奪得帝位，即位之初對北魏的態度十分倨傲，書信與接待多有輕慢，北魏使者回報後，兩國的舊怨重新被翻出來。蕭衍自己則想趁北魏新君初立、內部未穩之際取回淮北，幾次派兵北伐失利後，北魏遂轉為大舉反攻，局勢就此拉成持久戰。此外，南齊降將蕭寶夤、陳伯之熟悉淮南山川城守的實情，魏軍得此嚮導，等於把自己的攻擊路線交給對手，使原本因水險而難以速取的淮東戰線有了可用的突破口。
causeEn: The reasons for fighting were of two kinds, one remote and one close. The remote cause was the shape of the frontier between the two courts: the prefectures between the Huai and the Han had changed hands repeatedly, and the stretch of Zhongli, Shouyang, Yiyang and Huaiyin formed the doorway of the river country, so that whoever held these points held the grain traffic of the lower river and the springboard for any advance to the north. After the reforms of Sinicisation and the move of the capital to Luoyang under Emperor Xiaowen, Northern Wei had grown stronger and its weight had shifted southward; and when Xiaowen died and the new emperor was scarcely settled on his throne, the northern court had reason to straighten out its southern line of defence. The proximate cause lay on the Liang side. Xiao Yan had taken the throne from the Southern Qi only in the tenth month of 502, and at the beginning of his reign his manner towards Northern Wei was thoroughly haughty, with the letters and the reception of envoys marked by condescension; once the northern envoys had reported this home, the old grievances of the two states were dug up again. Xiao Yan himself wanted to recover the territory north of the Huai while the new northern emperor was still new and the north unsettled, and after his own northern expeditions had gone wrong the initiative passed to Wei, which counter-attacked in force, and the affair was drawn out into a war of attrition. In addition, the surrendered officers Xiao Baoyin and Chen Bozhi knew the rivers, mountains and fortifications of the Huai region, and the northern army's possession of such guides was in effect a gift of its own approach to a foe who knew the ground, giving the eastern side of the Huai a usable breach where the river crossings had made it hard to take a city quickly.
impact: 這一輪拉鋸改變了南北兩朝的邊防版圖，也改變了各自的內部政治。梁朝從此把淮南防線視為國本，鍾離、壽陽、義陽等城一律重兵駐守，興築城壘、修濬城池、加固堰壩，並在皖口、歷陽一帶推行屯田積穀，使淮南前線的糧源由建康漕運與本地屯墾兩條腿支撐。人才方面，曹景宗、韋叡、羊侃、陳慶之這一輩將領在實戰中成形，蕭衍對北方的用兵經驗也由此累積，晚年再議北伐時兵制、器械與漕運都與天監初年判若兩事。對北魏，這場戰爭卻是加速其崩解的一環：多次南下的消耗與京畿防務的空虛，讓北方邊鎮的守備日益鬆弛，六鎮之亂在523年爆發，528年河陰之難屠戮朝士，534年北魏分裂為東魏、西魏。527年陳慶之直抵洛陽則是壓垮尊嚴的一擊，南方騎兵竟能以數千之眾打到都城之下，北方朝廷的威信由此折損，爾朱榮的崛起也在這層羞辱中加速。梁朝的代價則是長期的消耗，壽陽的敗仗與空虛使蕭衍晚年更重佛事、廣建寺塔，府庫與民力被拉得極長，南方內部的失衡也埋下侯景之亂的種子。
impactEn: This grinding contest changed the map of the frontier for both courts and changed their domestic politics as well. The Liang thereafter treated the Huai line as the foundation of the state: Zhongli, Shouyang and Yiyang were all held by heavy garrisons, the ramparts were raised, the ditches and the dams repaired, and military colonies were established at Wankou and Liyang to accumulate grain, so that the food of the Huai front stood on two supports, the grain boats from Jiankang and the fields of the country itself. As for the men, a generation of generals in Cao Jingzong, Wei Rui, Yang Kan and Chen Qingzhi was formed in the field, and Xiao Yan's experience of fighting in the north accumulated with each campaign, so that by the time he came to discuss another northern expedition late in his reign, the army system, the equipment and the river transport were a different matter from what they had been in the first years of Tianjian. For Northern Wei, however, the war was one of the things that hastened its dissolution. The cost of repeated southern campaigns and the thinness of the capital's defences left the northern frontier garrisons more and more slack, the revolt of the six garrisons broke out in 523, the massacre of the River Yin in 528 cut down the men of the court, and in 534 Northern Wei split into Eastern and Western Wei. The stroke of 527, when Chen Qingzhi reached Luoyang, was a blow to northern pride: southern cavalry had carried the fight to the walls of the capital with only a few thousand men, the authority of the northern court was diminished, and the rise of Erzhu Rong was hastened by that humiliation. Liang's own price was paid in long attrition, the defeats before Shouyang and the emptied treasuries drove Xiao Yan in his last years to favour the Buddhist works and to raise temples without measure, and the strain on the stores and on the people of the south laid the seeds of the Hou Jing disaster.
result: 逐段看結果，雙方都沒有取得決定性的收場。503年北魏首攻鍾離，圍城近一年而不能下，最終因糧秣不濟與疫疾退去；同一線上的義陽卻被元英攻破，北魏據此置郡，梁朝在淮南失一處外圍據點，此役魏方小勝。504年之後兩國進入相對沉寂的對峙，梁朝轉而整軍經略，試圖以小股兵力收復失地。507年鍾離再戰是全役的關鍵：魏軍傾力攻擊淮渚城失利，死傷以萬計，宵營潰退，梁軍乘勝收復淮南數城，韋叡、曹景宗一系的守城與築柵之術自此為南朝所重。508年之後梁軍屢攻壽陽不克，514年蕭宏部更在壽陽城下折損萬餘，蕭衍隨即貶其封邑，淮南的攻勢自此收斂。527年陳慶之率五千騎破奚落生十萬援軍，直抵洛陽、逼走孝明帝，是戰役的極致，北魏的國際聲望與內部士氣都受到重創，但孤軍深入終究無法改變南北力量對比。整場戰爭的結論是：梁守住並鞏固了淮南防線，北魏保住洛陽並拖垮了梁的國力，兩者在江淮一線的爭奪一直延續到侯景之亂改變天下格局為止。
resultEn: Taken part by part, neither side obtained a decisive conclusion. In 503 the first northern attack on Zhongli failed to take the city after a siege of close to a year and was withdrawn when provisions ran short and sickness spread; on the same line, however, Yiyang was taken by Yuan Ying, Wei set up a commandery there, and the Liang lost an outlying position on the Huai, so that the opening stage went to the north. After 504 the two states settled into a relative quiet, the Liang reorganising its troops and works and trying to recover lost ground with small forces. The second battle of Zhongli in 507 was the hinge of the whole campaign: the northern army threw its weight against the fort of Huizhu and failed with losses counted in ten thousands, broke up and retreated by night, the Liang took up the opportunity and recovered several towns on the Huai, and the arts of holding walls and raising palisades practised by Wei Rui and Cao Jingzong came to be valued in the south. After 508 the Liang repeatedly failed before Shouyang, and in 514 the troops of Xiao Hong lost more than ten thousand men in front of the same city, whereupon Xiao Yan stripped him of his fief and the Liang offensive on the Huai closed up. In 527 Chen Qingzhi broke the hundred thousand men of Xiluosheng with five thousand cavalry, drove to Luoyang and forced Emperor Xiaoming to flee, which was the extreme point of the war: the northern court's standing and its morale were both badly hit, but a single army pushed deep into hostile country could not in the end alter the balance of power between north and south. The conclusion of the whole business is this: the Liang held and consolidated its line on the Huai, Northern Wei kept Luoyang and exhausted Liang's strength in the process, and the contest for the river country between them continued until the Hou Jing rebellion changed the order of the world.
